theme_strategy.justification: User specifically requested 'Açık tema' (Light theme) to convey a clean, professional, and clinical yet warm health consultancy environment.

headings.usage: Use for all module titles, KPI numbers, and Kanban column headers. Provides excellent numeric legibility and a modern, friendly but structural feel.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, CRM lists, patient notes, and forms. Extremely legible at small sizes for dense data.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS CLARITY
rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid warm off-white backgrounds.
Use #065F46 (Deep Emerald) as the primary brand color for main buttons and active states.
Use #0D9488 (Sophisticated Turquoise) strictly for data highlights, progress bars, and badges.

layouts.global_structure: Collapsible left sidebar (240px wide, white bg, 1px right border) + Main Content Area.

spacing_system.dashboard_grid: Tight gap-4 for dense data correlation. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 for KPI cards.
spacing_system.kanban_board: Horizontal flex container with gap-6. Columns should have min-w-[320px] and subtle gray bg (#F3F4F6) with no borders.
spacing_system.padding: Use generous padding (p-8) for page containers. Table cells should use compact padding (py-3 px-4) to maximize data visibility.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. 1px border (#E5E7EB). rounded-xl. NO ambient drop shadows by default. Add shadow-sm ONLY on hover for interactive cards (like Kanban items).
cards.header: Border-bottom (border-b) inside cards to separate title from content cleanly.

tables.style: High-density. sticky header. Use alternating row colors (bg-white and bg-gray-50/50) or simple bottom borders.
tables.actions: Hover-to-reveal action buttons (Edit/Delete) on the right side of rows.

tabs.style: Pill-shaped tabs (bg-gray-100, text-gray-600, active: bg-white text-emerald-800 shadow-sm) instead of standard underlines. Perfect for Customer Profile (Genel Bakış, Ölçümler, vb.).

badges.style: Soft background + dark text. E.g., Follow-up task (bg-amber-100 text-amber-800), Graduate (bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800).

visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They look professional and clinical.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Borders' concept for the Dashboard KPI section to make it look structural and data-heavy.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Do not show blank screens. Show a soft, muted icon with 'Henüz veri yok' (No data yet) and a clear 'Yeni Ekle' (Add New) button.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions only. Hover states must change background or border color. Buttons should have active:scale-95.
motion.kanban: Smooth transform on drag. Add a slight rotation (rotate-1) and shadow-lg when a Kanban card is being dragged.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #065F46 on #FFFFFF exceeds APCA standards. All muted text must be at least #6B7280.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='lead-kanban-card', data-testid='add-customer-btn').

consultant_avatar.usage: Use as the placeholder avatar for the 'Danışman' (Consultant) profile in the top-right header or settings page.

product_thumbnail.usage: Use as a placeholder image for the 'Ürünler' (Products) catalog module.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-beautiful-dnd or @hello-pangea/dnd for the Kanban pipeline (Potansiyel Müşteriler).
Use recharts for the 'Raporlar' (Reports) module. Apply the custom chart_palette provided.
Ensure all text is in Turkish as requested (Potansiyel Müşteriler, Aktif Müşteriler, vb.).
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with the exact colors from this JSON.
Implement Shadcn UI components but strip away the default 'Vercel' look; apply the flat, 1px border style specified here.
Do NOT center align the main app container. It's a dashboard, it should stretch to full width/height.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., Duplicate check warnings, task completions).
